content.title: City Council
content.summary: The City Council consists of several members, including Mayor Lauren Simpson, Mayor Pro Tem Randy Moorman, and councilmembers representing various districts: Shawna Ambrose (District 2), Rebecka Lovisone (District 3), Bob Fifer (District 4), and at-large members Sharon Davis and Michael Griffith. Each councilmember has a designated role and district representation within the city government.
